Transformer Manufacturers

A growing, sourced directory of transformer makers — power, distribution and dry-type/cast-resin — listed country by country, with locations and official links. Coverage expands as public records are confirmed; this is not every workshop worldwide.

Company pages lead with the place, products and sourced figures already on that record. A year of establishment is printed only when the census already has one. Listings are compiled from public sources. Verification confirms company identity and published profile data. It does not constitute technical certification, factory approval or commercial endorsement.

The public company count and the sitemap use the same census. 1053 companies are public. 173 published profiles are in the sitemap. A published profile has a public website and multiple sourced fields. 880 company pages stay reachable and out of the sitemap: no public website, or a thin listing without that sourced detail. 249 other sitemap URLs under /manufacturers/ are country and product directories, not additional companies. 85 manufacturer URLs redirect and are omitted. 7 plant aliases are hidden because the company is already counted. Group pages that are not census companies are left out of the sitemap.

Searchable sourcing directory → filter by transformer type, voltage, country and capability evidence, then compare and RFQ. No ranking.

Type hubs: Power · Distribution · Dry-type · Sourced: Power · 400 kV+ · Cooling and MVA

Verified facts and company declarations are labelled separately. A verified fact was checked against a source other than the supplier statement. A company declaration is quoted from the supplier and linked. An empty field is —. Supplier Qualification Passport is coming soon.

Region and country combine with search and category. The address keeps ?region= and ?country= so a filtered view can be shared.

Buyers may need origin information for grid equipment under upcoming rules in the United States and the European Union. Declared origin is the country of manufacture a supplier states on its own site or in a filing. Where no statement is on file, the field shows —. This is not legal advice.

Voltage and annual MVA use the sourced tier record. Cooling class and test evidence use the sourced spec record. Standards use either record. A maker with no sourced figure for an active filter is hidden. Countries stay in pages of 20.
